messages:
Maria P: Quick q — running through SI co-sell routing for pipeline that originates from cloud marketplace and HW reseller events. Want a simple orchestration so we don't double-claim.
Aj K: We usually prefer first-touch claims but for marketplace leads we tag `source=marketplace` and route to SI queue if partner match.
Devon L: Idea: 'lead conductor' pattern — canonical owner stored in SFDC mapping table; priority rules: marketplace > inbound demo; HW events prefer field unless SI engaged.
Sophie R: Can we add automatic 24h claim window and then escalate to SI-ops? That helped last quarter.
Lee C: Agree. Also need account mapping rules for duplicates: prefer net-new accounts to partner; for existing account check ARR threshold >100k to trigger AE/Field.
Maria P: Nice. Can someone draft a minimal playbook? Thinking short pseudocode for the automation.
Devon L: I'll drop a snippet:
``` 
if lead.source == 'marketplace' and partner.matches():
  assign(team='SI', owner=partner.si_rep)
elif lead.source == 'hw_event' and partner.hw_reseller:
  assign(team='Field', owner=field_rep)
else:
  assign(team='Growth', owner=default_ae)
```
marketplace-bot: webhook: Marketplace lead received: id=87342 origin=AtlasOne mapped_partner=NimbusGear
Aj K: Add gating: if account.exists and account.ARR > 100000 -> route to AE/Field; otherwise SI.
Sophie R: :thumbsup: Also add 'no_claim' tag when under NDA or custom deal; manual review.
Lee C: We should list systems: SFDC fields `si_owner`, `lead_source_detail`, marketplace webhook field `mp_origin`.
Maria P: Thanks. Can we finalize short rules of engagement: 24h claim window, owner persists for 14 days unless released, SI gets co-sell credit if engaged within 30 days.
Devon L: I'll make a Confluence draft and ping legal for crediting terms. ETA tomorrow.
Aj K: cc @Sophie R for ops handoff checklist.
Sophie R: On it — will add items: intro email template, joint NDA step, trial access instructions.
Maria P: Perfect. Quick follow-up: any objections to auto-fallback to 'redwood-dedicated' routing if SI unavailable? avoids stall.
Lee C: No objections. Just ensure telemetry and audit logs.
Maria P: Great. I'll open a short pilot for AtlasOne + NimbusGear next week. Thanks team :rocket:
